HOOK_TOKEN.description: Generate a unique random token in your password manager for webhook senders.

MCP_TOKEN.description: Generate a separate random token for read-only Muse connectors.

MCP_ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Generate a separate random token for your admin Muse connector. Save it for the Bearer token field in Muse.

MUSE_NODE_ID.description: Enter the node ID of your authorized Muse device.

MUSE_SDK_TOKEN.description: Enter the Gadget SDK token used when authorizing this device.

MUSE_REFRESH_TOKEN.description: Enter the current refresh token for this device identity. Stop any executor sharing the identity before handoff.
